title: Electromagnetism Basics
text: Electromagnetism is the branch of physics dealing with the electromagnetic force, one of the four fundamental forces of nature. It unifies electricity and magnetism, described by Maxwell's equations. Moving electric charges generate magnetic fields, and changing magnetic fields induce electric currents. This principle underlies technologies such as electric motors, generators, transformers, and wireless communication. Light itself is an electromagnetic wave, spanning a spectrum from radio waves to gamma rays.
